title: Bermuda Triangle
description: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

title: First Daughter
description: A female Secret Service agent (Mariel Hemingway) and a river guide (Doug Savant) must rescue the president's kidnapped daughter (Monica Keena).

title: First Shot
description: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

title: First Target
description: A Secret Service agent trains long and hard to protect the president, only to realize too late that the opening of new mountain transport in Seattle is just a ploy to ambush him.

title: In the Line of Fire
description: An assassin toys with a White House Secret Service agent haunted for 30 years by his failure in 1963 Dallas.

title: Air Force One
description: Demanding the release of a political prisoner, a terrorist and his gang hijack the U.S. president's plane.

title: Maximum Risk
description: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.

title: Cowboy Up
description: While dreaming of becoming a champion bull-rider, a rising star (Marcus Thomas) falls for the woman (Daryl Hannah) his brother (Kiefer Sutherland) loves.

title: Against All Odds
description: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.

title: The Deep
description: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: Air
description: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

title: Cold Comes the Night
description: A motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a blind thief to be his eyes while he tracks down his cash.

title: Crazy in Alabama
description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: Wild Things
description: A Florida police officer investigates when two teens accuse a high-school guidance counselor of rape.

title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
description: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Murphy's Romance
description: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.

title: Spanglish
description: A single mother (Paz Vega) becomes a housekeeper for a laid-back chef (Adam Sandler) and his neurotic wife (Téa Leoni).

title: Enough
description: After running away fails, a terrified woman (Jennifer Lopez) empowers herself in order to battle her abusive husband (Billy Campbell).

description: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney who joins another law firm after the death of his boss and mentor. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murder.

title: The Net
